verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools directly to meeting data. It has a dedicated MCP configuration page and a help-center article, OAuth-based connection to ChatGPT with no API key required, and named MCP tools such as fireflies_share_meeting, fireflies_move_meeting and fireflies_create_soundbite. A separate Docs MCP server is also offered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and use the server successfully.
